scheme_name: Dr. P. G. Solanki Scheme for Loan/Assistance to Law Graduates of Scheduled Caste
other_conditions: Applicant must be a law graduate
benefits_summary: Provides ₹12,000 assistance (₹7,000 loan at 4% interest and ₹5,000 subsidy) for purchasing a business premises or shop.
documents_required: Attested copy of Bar Council registration certificate
